segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: You walk over to the small, circular window and use your mitten to wipe away the thick layer of frost. Outside, the fifty-foot wooden waterwheel is frozen solid in the river ice. But as moonlight hits the spokes, you notice something strange: the shadow cast by the wheel onto the mill wall doesn't match the wheel at all! The shadow reveals a hidden inner spoke—and it points directly at the iron stove in the corner!

segments.speaker: hero
segments.text: Look at the shadow! It's pointing at your stove!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Pip declares, bounding across the room.

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: The stove! Naturally, I was keeping my tea warm on the primary control mechanism!
